options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: extra_filler_checks
options.description:
Extra generic AP Check locations.
Default is 50.
These are filled with Progressive Filler.
Max is 200.

options.name: starting_symbol_mode
options.description:
How AP floors start while AP Check locations remain.
ap_checks = start each run with five AP Check symbols.
starting_symbols = start with Coin, Flower, Pearl, Cherry, Cat and find AP Check through symbol choices.

options.name: goal_mode
options.description:
Choose the floor goal mode.
chosen_floor = one target floor.
chosen_floors = selected target floors.

options.name: chosen_floor
options.description: The single floor used when Goal Mode is chosen_floor.

options.name: chosen_floors
options.description:
Floors used when goal_mode is chosen_floors.
Example:
chosen_floors: [1, 5, 12]

options.name: floors_required
options.description:
How many selected floors must be cleared.
0 = random amount.
Values above selected floor count are clamped.

options.name: floor_unlock_mode
options.description:
How selected AP floors are available.
start_with_all = all selected floors start open.
unlock_through_items = first floor starts open, others need Unlock Floor items.

options.name: floor_payment_checks
options.description:
Payment check style.
shared = one Payment 1-12 chain for the slot.
per_floor = Floor X Payment Y checks for selected floors.

options.name: item_bundles
options.description:
Bundle multiple unlocks into one AP item.
The client unlocks everything listed inside the bundle.

options.name: item_bundle_size
options.description:
Maximum unlocks inside each bundle.
Only used when item_bundles is on.
Max is 10.

options.name: two_item_bundles
options.description:
Force bundles to contain 2 unlocks each.
The final leftover bundle may have 1.

options.name: force_sphere_one_symbols
options.description:
Symbol unlocks forced into sphere 1.
Example:
force_sphere_one_symbols: [Crab]

options.name: rare_checks
options.description:
Include Rare First-Get checks.
off = rare content is not AP checks/items.
Use rare_very_rare_in_game_pool to keep them in-game.

options.name: very_rare_checks
options.description:
Include Very Rare First-Get checks.
off = very rare content is not AP checks/items.
Use rare_very_rare_in_game_pool to keep them in-game.

options.name: rare_very_rare_in_game_pool
options.description:
Allow removed Rare/Very Rare checks in-game.
on = they can appear normally in LBAL at their regular rarity chance.
They still are not AP checks or AP unlock items.

options.name: item_randomizer
options.description:
Randomize normal items as AP unlocks/checks.
off = normal items are vanilla
and can appear without AP unlocks.

options.name: essence_randomizer
options.description:
Randomize essences as AP unlocks/checks.
off = essences are vanilla
and can appear without AP unlocks.

options.name: progressive_ap_checks
options.description:
Start with AP Check 1-10.
Each Progressive AP Checks item opens the next 10 checks.
Keeps sphere logic clean.

options.name: unlockable_chance_boost
options.description:
Boost newly AP-unlocked content in-game.
off = normal LBAL rarity chances.
on = use unlockable_chance_boost_mode.

options.name: unlockable_chance_boost_mode
options.description:
How boost mode works.
regular = normal LBAL rarity chances.
category = boost current symbol/item/essence category.
category_and_rarity = boost current category and matching rarity.

options.name: deathlink
options.description:
Enable DeathLink.
Incoming DeathLinks end the current run.
Failing to pay rent sends a DeathLink.

options.name: deathlink_receive_chance
options.description:
Chance that an incoming DeathLink ends your run.
100 = always.

options.name: deathlink_receive_threshold
options.description: Incoming DeathLinks needed before one is applied.

options.name: deathlink_send_threshold
options.description: Failed rent runs needed before sending DeathLink.

options.name: force_payment_trap_counts_deathlink
options.display_name: Force Payment Trap Counts For DeathLink
options.description:
If enabled, a run ended by the Force Payment trap can count toward outgoing DeathLink.
If disabled, Force Payment trap failures are ignored for outgoing DeathLink.

options.name: raspberry_pool
options.description:
Number of Raspberry AP items in the pool.
0 disables Raspberry goal mode.
Max is 50.

options.name: raspberry_required
options.description:
Number of Raspberry items required to finish.
0 = require all Raspberry items in the pool.
Max is 50.

options.name: buffs
options.description: Replace a percentage of filler checks with enabled buff items.

options.name: buff_percentage
options.description: Percentage of filler checks replaced by buff items when Buffs is on.

options.name: start_destroy_token_buff_weight
options.display_name: Start With a Destroy Token Buff Weight

options.name: start_reroll_token_buff_weight
options.display_name: Start With a Reroll Token Buff Weight

options.name: start_essence_token_buff_weight
options.display_name: Start With an Essence Token Buff Weight

options.name: traps
options.description: Replace a percentage of filler checks with enabled trap items.

options.name: trap_percentage
options.description: Percentage of filler checks replaced by trap items when Traps is on.
